start: A new MettleUp version is out; the member opens the app

steps.action: The app shows its update screen and asks app.mettleup.fit/app/whats-new.json first
user_sees: 'A new MettleUp is here' with up to 5 What's new lines of the newest release
must_not: An empty list of lines when the release has them
Lines of an older version

start: GitHub does not answer and no last good copy is kept

steps.action: The app opens its update screen
user_sees: The server answers 'not available' (503); the app tries GitHub second (the app's fallback words not read)
must_not: An app crash
A screen stuck loading

start: A release came out a few minutes ago

steps.action: Open the update screen within 10 minutes of the release
user_sees: The lines of the version kept in the last 10 minutes (possibly the previous release)
must_not: The previous release's lines kept longer than 10 minutes after GitHub answers

start: A request arrives with no fresh copy cached

steps.action: Ask GitHub's release API for the newest release and fetch its whats-new.json
user_sees: A version like 1.2.3 and its lines (blank lines dropped, at most 5)
must_not: A file without a version passed on

steps.action: Keep the answer
user_sees: A fresh copy for 10 minutes and a last good copy for a week
must_not: A bad answer kept as the last good copy

start: GitHub's API refuses (for example its hourly limit for calls without a token)

steps.action: Try the second door, the release download link
user_sees: The same file read from the download link
must_not: A 503 while the second door works

start: The newest release has no whats-new.json, or a broken one

steps.action: Both doors fail
user_sees: The last good copy (cached 60 seconds) or 503 'not available'
must_not: The broken file passed to the phones

steps.action: A POST arrives
user_sees: 'Method not allowed' (405)
must_not: The cache changed by the POST

start: GitHub has been down for more than a week

steps.action: A request arrives after the kept copy ran out
user_sees: 503 'not available'
must_not: A copy older than a week served as fresh

steps.action: On the old version, do "What's new lines for the app's update screen, served from our own server" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
